senses.gloss: to stretch, reach; to arrive at; to obtain; to happen to.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 11:4">Targ. Gen. XI, 4</cite> (Y. II <he>מַמְטֵי</he>). Targ. O. ib. X, 19 (h. text <he>באכה</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 19:26">Targ. II Kings XIX, 26</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 8:14">Targ. Koh. VIII, 14</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 5:2">Targ. Esth. V, 2</cite> [read:] <he>ומְטָת לִידָהּ</he> and it (the scepter) reached her hand (v.
<cite ref="Megillah 15b">Meg. 15ᵇ</cite>).—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109a:2">Snh. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מ׳ להאי וכ׳</he> when he arrived at a certain inn.
<cite ref="Ketubot 63a:1">Keth. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מַטְיָא לגביה</he> when she came near him.
<cite ref="Ketubot 63a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ מעלי וכ׳</he> the eve of the Day of Atonement came.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 12b:11">R. Hash. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>א״ר אסי א״ר יוחנן ומָטוּ בה משמיה וכ׳</he> said R. A. in the name of R. Joh., and they arrived in the chain of tradition up to ‘in the name of R. J. the Galilean’ (an editorial gloss).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:18">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵃ</cite> top, a. fr. <he>מַטְתֵיה אונס</he> an accident (mourning) befell him.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:8:12">Y. Peah VIII, end, 21ᵇ</cite> <he>ומטתיה כן</he> and so it happened to him (as he had wished).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:8:12">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא מ׳ מיכול וכ׳</he> and he had no chance to dine with him.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:6:5">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>בעי מַמְטֵי מיא ולא מ׳</he> wanted to fetch water but could not. Ib. 78ᵃ top <he>כל דמָטֵי וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00124"><he>זוֹגָא</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>כל מטי יעבוד וכ׳</he>, read: <he>כל חד מינן וכ׳</he> let each of us do &c.] <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:1:6">Y. Keth. IV, 28ᵇ</cite> top <he>מְטִינְתָּה להאי דאמר וכ׳</he> thou hast found that which R … said; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:1:6">ib.</cite> <cite ref="M00297"><he>מְטִינְתָּא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Chagigah 5a:15">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מ׳ להאי קרא</he> when he came to this verse.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 100a:4">Snh. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מָטוּ מגלת וכ׳</he> when (in preparing wrappers for the scrolls) they came to the roll of Esther; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Chullin 132a">Ḥull. 132ᵃ</cite> top <cite ref="M00985"><he>מָטוּנָךְ</he></cite> we or they (the words of the text) have reached thee, agree with thee, Rashi; v. <cite ref="I00185"><he>טוּנָא</he> I</cite>.]

senses.gloss: (sub. בישולא or זימנא) to be ripe, ready. Ḥag. l. c. שביק הנך דמָטוּ וֹכ׳ he left those (figs) which were ripe and plucked those which were not.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 112a:10">Ḥull. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>תיתאה מטא</he> the lower portion was ready (roasted).

senses.gloss: to cause to reach; to fetch, bring, offer. [Targ. Y. II, Gen. XI, 4 מַמְטֵי part. pass., v. supra.] Targ. Y. ib. XXVII, 25.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 9:12">Targ. O. Lev. IX, 12</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:13">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>דרי ואַמְטֵי בהדן</he> take it up and hand it over (to the King’s treasury) in our presence; <he>דרא וא׳ וכ׳</he> he did take it up &c. Ib. 119ᵇ, a. e. <he>אַמְטוּיֵי ואתויי חד</he> (not <he>אמטוי</he>) is leading the needle forth and bringing it home one stitch (= h. <he>הוליך והביא</he>)? <cite ref="Bava Batra 21a:9">B. Bath. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מַמְטִינָן וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="J00431"><he>יָנוּקָא</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 103b">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>אַמְטְיוּהִי לצ׳ וכ׳</he> they took him to Sepphoris which lies high.
